Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, especially teen drivers, for whom the manual names distraction as a leading crash cause.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the following-time rules are frequent knowledge-test items [A06], and the wet-road and hydroplaning figures are exact values worth memorizing [A08].
Level: mixed recall and judgment; several look-alike figures (three, four and six seconds; thirty-five and fifty-five mph; car lengths by speed); moderate to high load.
Prerequisites: the stopping distance and braking pages of the vehicle-control section.
